_comment: VERL (Volcano Engine Reinforcement Learning for LLMs) Recipe Template Parameters Configuration
This file defines template structure and parameters for VERL recipes using
reinforcement learning algorithms like GRPO and PPO for fine-tuning.
1. TEMPLATE MATCHING: Supports verl_grpo and verl_ppo algorithm types
2. RL-SPECIFIC PARAMETERS: Includes reward model, critic, and actor configurations
3. SFT/DPO TEMPLATES: sft, sft_fft, dpo and dpo_fft also expose the llmft override names
(logging_steps, generation_cfg, gradient_clipping, seed, ...), so a job spec written for an
llmft recipe is accepted. Placeholders a recipe does not carry are pruned from its overrides.
The Nemotron recipes run in a separate container that does not support those keys yet, so they
use the *_nemotron copies (sft_nemotron, sft_fft_nemotron, dpo_nemotron, dpo_fft_nemotron).

warmup_steps.description: Number of training steps over which the learning rate rises linearly from 0 to its target value. A positive value overrides lr_warmup_steps_ratio, while -1 or 0 uses lr_warmup_steps_ratio instead. To turn warmup off, set both this and lr_warmup_steps_ratio to 0.

min_lr.description: Lowest learning rate the cosine schedule decays to, as a fraction of the peak learning rate. For example, 0.1 ends training at 10% of the peak and 0 decays it to zero. Has no effect when lr_scheduler is constant.

dataset_max_len.description: Maximum number of tokens in a single training example (prompt + completion). Longer sequences capture more context but use more memory.

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step.

global_batch_size.description: Total number of samples processed per optimizer step across all GPUs and accumulation steps. Larger batch sizes provide more stable gradients but require more memory.

adam_beta.description: KL divergence penalty coefficient for DPO. Controls how much the policy is penalized for deviating from the reference model. Lower values allow more deviation.

lr_warmup_steps_ratio.description: Fraction of total training steps spent linearly ramping the learning rate from 0 up to the target value. Stabilizes early training by avoiding large initial updates.

lora_rank.description: Rank of the low-rank decomposition in LoRA adapters. Higher rank increases expressiveness but uses more memory and compute.
